Definition: Derived mean 43/41 occupants per excavated occupied ferret den: 39 single occupants and two pairs in 41 excavations (Norbury et al. 1998 p.154). Selected dens contained radio-collared ferrets; not a random sample or necessarily independent animals. Feral Mustela furo, mapped to the project ferret anchor Mustela putorius furo. Daytime den occupancy is distinct from stable social-group size; later telemetry sharing is outside this denominator.
